about: Fresh-site eval: goals on sites the navigator was never tuned on (retail, travel, governments, developer docs, media), to find new kinds of failure rather than to score the known ones. Each case starts at its site's home page. A run succeeds when the navigator reports Reached and the final URL or title contains one of the keywords (and none of `avoid`). When the navigator hands back for text, the eval types the case's `query` and Enter, as the calling agent would, up to twice. Run with `aibrowse eval navigator --suite evals/fresh.json`.
